prayer.title: Salat al-Janaza
prayer.subtitle: Takbira naani
prayer.takbir_1_intro: Niyya sɛbɛn i hakili kɔnɔ ka Salat al-Janaza seli, k'i bolo kɔrɔ ta dama la ani k'a fɔ:
prayer.takbir_2_intro: Takbira filanan fɔ k'i bolo ta dabɔ, ka Salat Ibrahimiyya kalan:
prayer.takbir_3_intro: Takbira sabanan fɔ, ka Allah daali saranen kama:
prayer.takbir_3_for_woman: Muso kama (لَهُ yɛlɛma ka kɛ لَهَا):
prayer.takbir_3_note: Nin dua bɔra hadith sahihi la Muslim (963) ɲɛ.
prayer.takbir_4_intro: Takbira naanin ni laban fɔ, ka dua dɔgɔman fɔ laban la:
prayer.tip_1: Salat al-Janaza bɛ seli ni wolonton ye, ruku' walima sujud tɛ yen.
prayer.tip_2: Saff cogoya dɔgɔman ka jɛ tɛ, nka saff kɔnɔ seli ka ɲɛ.
prayer.tip_3: A bɛ se ka seli tile kɔnɔ lɛrɛ bɛɛ la, sɛnɛnw bɔ lɛrɛw la.
prayer.tip_4: Tabulu ka kan ka sigi imam ɲɛ. Tchè ma, imam bɛ sigi k'a kunna ɲɛ.
prayer.merits_subtitle: Janaza seli bɛ faa di saranen ni baarakɛlaw ma.
prayer.merit_1_body: Annabi ﷺ y'a fɔ: "Mɔgɔ si tɛ wuli ka seli musuluman min sara kan, mɔgɔ bi naani ni firtin tɔgɔ tɛ baliya Allah la, nka Allah bɛna u ka shafaati minɛ a kama." (Muslim 948) Mɔgɔ ca ni bɛ gɛlɛya ka ɲɛ.
prayer.merit_2_body: Annabi ﷺ y'a fɔ: "Min bɛ janaza ta ka tɛmɛna seli la, a bɛna qirat sɔrɔ, min bɛ tɛmɛna kanbelen la, a bɛna qirat fila sɔrɔ." (Al-Bukhari 1325, Muslim 945)
prayer.merit_3_body: Janaza yɔrɔ taa bɛ nin hakili don e la ka ɲɛ, baara min bɛ jukɔrɔ nɔ ka tawba ni yɛrɛyɛlɛma kɛ. Annabi ﷺ y'a fɔ: "Sara hakili caya." (At-Tirmidhi 2307, Ibn Majah 4258)
prayer.takbir_fr: Allah ka bon tɛmɛ fɛɛn bɛɛ la
prayer.fatiha_fr: Bisimillahi Rahmanir Rahim. Lafia Allah ta ye, diɲɛ bɛɛ Maslaw. Rahmanir Rahim. Kiriɲɛ don Maslaw. I dɔrɔn ka bɛ ka seli, i dɔrɔn bɛ se ɲinini kɛ. An bila sira tilennen na, minnu sɔrɔra hɛɛrɛ la, minnu tɛ fajiri ye, minnu tɛ bɔ kɔ la.
prayer.salat_ibrahimiyya_fr: Ee Allah, Muhammad ni a ka somɔgɔw kan barka don, Ibrahim ni a ka somɔgɔw kan barka don cogo la. I ka fɔ ka ɲɛ, bɔnya bɛ i bolo. Ee Allah, Muhammad ni a ka somɔgɔw barka, Ibrahim ni a ka somɔgɔw barka cogo la.
prayer.dua_man_fr: Ee Allah, a demisɛn, a la rahama kɛ, a mara ani a hakɛw muun. A sɔrɔli niuma kɛ, a yɔrɔ dɔrɔn caya. Jii, sira ni kurun ye a sɔ. A so yɛlɛma ka ɲɛ, a somɔgɔw yɛlɛma ka ɲɛ. A bila Janna na ani a mara Jahanama kaw la.
prayer.dua_woman_note: (Nin dua kelen ye nka bɔlonsɔgɔsɔgɔnw bɛ yɛlɛma musow kan.)
prayer.dua_final_fr: Ee Allah, nin ta faa k'an ta dɔn ka ɲɛ, n'an kan an fili a kɔfɛ, ani an ni a bɛɛ demisɛn.
prayer.salam_fr: Lafia ni Allah ka rahama tɛ aw bolo.
